dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Five prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures on the mid-dorsal region exhibit irregular, jagged light-tan perimeters. The gradient transitions sharply from the near-black exterior pelt to a high-intensity light-colored ring, with some rings enclosing a medium-grey interior that is lighter than the base pelt but darker than the perimeter.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: There is a high spatial density of small, asymmetrical, solid light-toned pixel clusters concentrated along the lower lateral flank and the base of the tail. these blobs lack internal gradients and appear as localized, high-intensity concentrations against the dark pelt background.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most distinct macro-annuli on the upper dorsal surface form an irregular trapezoidal polygon, with the pair closest to the flippers being more widely spaced than the anterior pair.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Two distinct, high-contrast red punctate lesions are visible at the junction where the hind flippers attach to the posterior body trunk.
other_distinctive_markers: The hind flippers exhibit a prominent ribbed texture characterized by longitudinal high-intensity light-colored ridges separated by low-intensity dark recessed grooves.
